steps.name: environment - validate runtimes, ensure jq, persist NODE env and sanitized PATH
steps.description: Validate Node (>=18) and npm presence, ensure jq is installed (non-interactive), compute npm/yarn global bin directories (only include existing dirs), and write an idempotent /etc/profile.d/stock_analyzer_frontend.sh that exports NODE_ENV=development, HOST=0.0.0.0, a literal defaulting expression for PORT, and a quoted PATH containing validated global bins. This ensures future shells inherit environment variables and tool paths safely.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
MIN_NODE_MAJOR=18
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_V_RAW=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
NODE_V=${NODE_V_RAW#v}
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_V%%.*}
if ! [[ "$NODE_MAJOR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt "$MIN_NODE_MAJOR" ]; then echo "node version $NODE_V_RAW found, require >= ${MIN_NODE_MAJOR}.x" >&2; exit 3; fi
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 4; }
# ensure jq (non-interactive)
if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq jq >/dev/null; fi
# compute validated global bins
NPM_GBIN="$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo /usr/local/bin)"
YARN_GBIN=""
if command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # yarn global bin works differently for berry; detect later in deps step
  YTMP=$(yarn global bin 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$YTMP" ] && YARN_GBIN="$YTMP"
fi
# build PATH with only existing dirs, avoid duplicates
NEW_PATH_ENTRIES=()
for p in "$NPM_GBIN" "$YARN_GBIN"; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  if [ -d "$p" ]; then NEW_PATH_ENTRIES+=("$p"); fi
done
# append existing PATH at login time; write literal defaulting for PORT
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/stock_analyzer_frontend.sh
TMPF=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMPF" <<'EOF'
# stock_analyzer_frontend persistent env
export NODE_ENV=development
export HOST=0.0.0.0
export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
# prepend validated npm/yarn global bins to PATH if present
EOF
if [ ${#NEW_PATH_ENTRIES[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  # join entries with : and quote the assignment
  IFS=:
  echo "export PATH=\"${NEW_PATH_ENTRIES[*]}:\$PATH\"" >> "$TMPF"
  unset IFS
else
  echo "# no extra global bins detected" >> "$TMPF"
fi
sudo mkdir -p /etc/profile.d && sudo chmod 755 /etc/profile.d
# idempotent write: replace only if different
if sudo test -f "$PROFILE"; then
  if ! sudo cmp -s "$TMPF" "$PROFILE" 2>/dev/null; then sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <"$TMPF" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"; else rm -f "$TMPF"; fi
else
  sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <"$TMPF" && sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
fi
rm -f "$TMPF"
# print versions for operator
node -v && npm -v || true
command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1 && yarn -v || true

steps.name: scaffolding - initialize CRA project only into empty workspace (safe guard)
steps.description: If package.json is missing and the workspace contains no files other than optional .git, initialize a create-react-app project in-place. Use global create-react-app when available or npx fallback. Do NOT force a package manager in scaffolding to avoid pm mismatch; persist nothing here. Ensure essential npm scripts exist in package.json after scaffold.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WS"
if [ -f package.json ]; then echo "package.json exists; skipping scaffold"; exit 0; fi
# robust emptiness check: count entries excluding .git
COUNT=$(find "$WS" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -not -name '.git' | readlink -f - 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$(find "$WS" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -not -name '.git' -print -quit)" ]; then echo "Workspace not empty and no package.json; will not scaffold to avoid overwrite. Add package.json or clean workspace." >&2; exit 5; fi
# scaffold: prefer global create-react-app if present, otherwise npx fallback
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  create-react-app . --silent || { echo "create-react-app failed" >&2; exit 6; }
else
  npx --yes create-react-app@latest . --silent || { echo "npx create-react-app failed" >&2; exit 7; }
fi
# ensure essential scripts exist (idempotent)
if [ -f package.json ]; then TMP=$(mktemp) && jq '(.scripts.start //= "react-scripts start") | (.scripts.build //= "react-scripts build") | (.scripts.test //= "react-scripts test --watchAll=false")' package.json > "$TMP" && mv "$TMP" package.json || { echo "failed to ensure package.json scripts" >&2; exit 8; }; fi

steps.name: dependencies - choose & persist package manager; install deps and validate bundler + yarn handling
steps.description: Determine effective package manager (use lockfiles if present, otherwise prefer yarn if available else npm), persist choice to .pm_choice. Require package.json present (fail-fast with guidance). Detect Yarn major version and fail with remediation if yarn v2+ (berry) is detected since classic commands differ. Ensure react/react-dom exist in package.json and add them if missing using chosen PM. Detect TypeScript usage and add dev deps if needed. Install project dependencies; namespace logs with workspace basename.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WS"
# ensure package.json exists
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then echo "package.json not found in workspace ($WS). Run scaffold or add package.json before installing dependencies." >&2; exit 9; fi
# determine package manager
PM=""
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then PM="yarn"; elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then PM="npm"; elif command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then PM="yarn"; else PM="npm"; fi
echo "$PM" > .pm_choice
# yarn version handling
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then
  YV=$(yarn -v 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
  YMAJOR=${YV%%.*}
  if ! [[ "$YV" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.|$) ]]; then echo "cannot parse yarn version: $YV" >&2; fi
  if [ "$YMAJOR" -ge 2 ]; then echo "Detected Yarn v2+ (berry) version $YV. This plan expects Yarn classic (v1) or npm. Recommended remediation: install yarn classic (e.g., 'npm i -g yarn@1') or switch to npm. Aborting." >&2; exit 10; fi
fi
LOG_BASE="/tmp/stock_frontend_$(basename "$WS")"
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$LOG_BASE")"
# ensure react/react-dom exist in package.json
HAS_REACT=$(jq -r '(.dependencies.react // .devDependencies.react) // empty' package.json || true)
if [ -z "$HAS_REACT" ]; then
  if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn add react react-dom 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" || { echo "yarn add react failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" >&2; exit 11; }; else npm i react react-dom --save 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" || { echo "npm install react failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" >&2; exit 12; }; fi
fi
# detect TypeScript usage (tsconfig or .ts/.tsx files)
if [ -f tsconfig.json ] || ls src/*.ts src/*.tsx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  HAS_TS=$(jq -r '(.devDependencies.typescript // .dependencies.typescript) // empty' package.json || true)
  if [ -z "$HAS_TS" ]; then
    if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn add -D typescript @types/react @types/react-dom 2>&1 | tee -a "${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" || { echo "yarn add typescript failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" >&2; exit 13; }; else npm i typescript @types/react @types/react-dom --save-dev 2>&1 | tee -a "${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" || { echo "npm install typescript failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_deps.log" >&2; exit 14; }; fi
  fi
fi
# install all deps
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn install 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_BASE}_install.log" || { echo "yarn install failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_install.log" >&2; exit 15; }; else
  # prefer npm ci when lockfile exists for reproducible install
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_BASE}_install.log" || { echo "npm ci failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_install.log" >&2; exit 16; }; else npm i --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_BASE}_install.log" || { echo "npm install failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_install.log" >&2; exit 17; }; fi
fi
# verify start/build scripts or react-scripts presence
HAS_START=$(jq -r '.scripts.start // empty' package.json || true)
HAS_BUILD=$(jq -r '.scripts.build // empty' package.json || true)
HAS_REACT_SCRIPTS=$(jq -r '(.dependencies["react-scripts"] // .devDependencies["react-scripts"]) // empty' package.json || true)
if [ -z "$HAS_START" ] && [ -z "$HAS_REACT_SCRIPTS" ]; then
  echo "Warning: No start script or react-scripts detected. For CRA projects add react-scripts (e.g., '$PM add react-scripts@latest' or update package.json scripts)." >&2
fi
# print chosen package manager
echo "PM=$PM"

steps.description: Build the app (if build script exists), start the dev server headless using the persisted package manager, capture PID ($!), derive PGID for cleanup, poll for readiness (any 2xx/3xx HTTP code) with a TCP-listen fallback, and ensure cleanup via trap. Provide namespaced logs in /tmp and explicit errors if PID or healthcheck fail.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/stock-insights-analyzer-234320-237759/stock_analyzer_frontend"
cd "$WS"
PM="$(cat .pm_choice 2>/dev/null || echo "npm")"
HOST=${HOST:-0.0.0.0}
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
LOG_BASE="/tmp/stock_frontend_$(basename "$WS")"
LOG_OUT="${LOG_BASE}_stdout.log"
LOG_ERR="${LOG_BASE}_stderr.log"
rm -f "$LOG_OUT" "$LOG_ERR"
# build if present
if jq -e '.scripts.build' package.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then yarn build 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_BASE}_build.log" || { echo "build failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_build.log" >&2; exit 21; }; else npm run build --if-present 2>&1 | tee "${LOG_BASE}_build.log" || { echo "build failed; see ${LOG_BASE}_build.log" >&2; exit 22; }; fi
fi
# ensure start script exists
if ! jq -e '.scripts.start' package.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "no start script found; cannot validate dev server" >&2; exit 23; fi
# determine START_CMD
if [ "$PM" = "yarn" ]; then START_CMD="yarn start"; else START_CMD="npm run start"; fi
# start server in background, capture PID
env NODE_ENV=development BROWSER=none HOST="$HOST" PORT="$PORT" bash -lc "$START_CMD" >"$LOG_OUT" 2>"$LOG_ERR" &
PID=$!
if [ -z "$PID" ] || ! ps -p "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "failed to start server or capture PID" >&2; echo "See $LOG_OUT and $LOG_ERR" >&2; exit 24; fi
# derive PGID for group termination
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$PID" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
if [ -z "$PGID" ]; then echo "failed to determine PGID for PID $PID" >&2; fi
cleanup(){
  if [ -n "$PGID" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || kill -TERM "$PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 2; kill -KILL -"$PGID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
# healthcheck: try HTTP (accept any 2xx/3xx), then fallback to tcp port listen
RETRIES=12
SLEEP=5
OK=1
for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do
  sleep $SLEEP
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" ) || CODE=000
    if [ "$CODE" -ge 200 ] && [ "$CODE" -lt 400 ]; then OK=0; break; fi
  fi
  # fallback: check listening TCP port
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if ss -ltn "sport = :${PORT}" | grep -q LISTEN; then OK=0; break; fi
  elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if netstat -ltn | awk '{print $4}' | grep -q ":${PORT}$"; then OK=0; break; fi
  fi
done
# output brief logs for operator
head -n 200 "$LOG_OUT" 2>/dev/null || true
head -n 200 "$LOG_ERR" 2>/dev/null || true
if [ $OK -ne 0 ]; then echo "validation failed: server did not become ready within timeout; see $LOG_ERR and $LOG_OUT" >&2; exit 25; fi
echo "validation succeeded: server responded on port ${PORT} (PID $PID)"
